items.title: Run failbunny.com audience, content, monetization, and measurement boundary assessment
items.summary: Produce a bounded site-specific assessment of failbunny.com covering observable audience positioning, content scope, conversion paths, monetization prerequisites, operational health, backlog priorities, and measurement boundaries. The authoritative snapshot records analytics as not configured; traffic, revenue, conversions, attribution, SEO, and health fields must remain unknown unless directly evidenced. Do not infer telemetry, revenue, ROI, or causal lift.
items.requested_action: Approve a bounded read-only assessment using existing intelligence and one public inspection of failbunny.com only. Do not deploy, modify production, change credentials or configuration, request duplicate telemetry, spend money, or claim unavailable outcomes.
